Definition: from G1537 and G2480; to have full strength, i.e. be entirely competent:--be able.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, exischýō is the word for be able. In Ephesians 3:18, the text says "May be able to comprehend with all saints what [is] the breadth."
TheologicalSignificance: I read exischýō plainly — it means be able, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
